parts.text: I worry about sudden airspace closures and planned ones coming into force while drones from several companies are already in the air, and these closures are often amended during the day. Radio coverage is patchy around ports, industrial sites, and in bad weather, and battery drains faster in cold and wind than planned. Links used to give instructions to drones and charging equipment are unreliable, so an instruction can get through twice when the sender cannot tell if the first attempt arrived.
